_comment: Per-env NON-SECRET config for the egpt DEV service. CORE_API_URL points the developer-identity api-client at the DEV core broker (the base file's localhost value is for local runs only). DEVELOPER_WALLET_ADDRESS is the app owner's PUBLIC wallet, the developer the microservice authenticates AS via reconnect_by_wallet; the matching DEVELOPER_SIGNATURE is a SECRET whose name the deploy lane derives from this service's app_id and mounts as env DEVELOPER_SIGNATURE. Never put a signature value in this checked-in file.
